name: MathOS Agentic Clay Research Curriculum
objective: Teach mathematically precise, falsifiable and independently reviewable research using bounded AI-assisted experiments, without certifying unsolved problems.

evaluation.mechanical_checks: source traceability, module/track structure, replay commands, bounded agent report invariants
evaluation.human_gates: subject-matter accuracy, mathematical proof validity, source novelty, formal proof scope, independent replication

modules.title: Proof statements and Clay source literacy
modules.goal: Distinguish complete Clay targets from authored MathOS proof routes.

weekly.assignment: Rewrite one Clay target with all variables and quantifiers; identify a deliberately weaker statement.
Map dimensions, domains, boundary or algebraic conditions to the canonical Clay target.
Reverse-engineer an existing open obligation; distinguish a necessary from a sufficient condition.
Supply one explicit counterexample to an invalid generalization of the first use case.

acceptance: full Clay target distinguished from the bounded example
a reviewer can replay the counterexample

modules.title: Reproducible seven-track experiments
modules.goal: Verify exact finite/conditional baselines and their limitations.

weekly.assignment: Run the seven hypothesis pipeline; fingerprint canonical inputs and record Python version.
Replay the reverse-oracle test for the chosen track and explain its different method.
Change one carefully chosen assumption on an isolated copy and record the observed failure.
Write the most important non-implication from the passing bounded probe to the full Clay target.

acceptance: controls distinguish valid and invalid cases
no finite result promoted to universal theorem

modules.title: Agentic planner–proposer–skeptic–reviewer
modules.goal: Operate the guarded AI-agent loop and identify unverified statements.

weekly.assignment: Run an offline agent rehearsal on one selected track; verify it is not a live AI run.
Draft an exact candidate lemma with hypotheses, domain, proposed proof and falsifier.
Challenge the proposed lemma with two counterexample searches and revise once.
Audit model access, privacy, input provenance, role budgets and the human-review handoff.

modules.title: Specialist mathematical attack
modules.goal: Move beyond the baseline to an honestly scoped substantive lemma.

weekly.assignment: Find and verify three primary mathematical sources directly; record which claims each supports.
Write one unproved lemma with all quantifiers and an explicit logical implication to the chosen Clay target.
Try to refute the lemma using examples, scaling, quantifier stress tests or known theorems.
Report a proof attempt with numbered steps and each unclosed assumption flagged.

modules.title: Formal proof and trusted verification
modules.goal: Separate compiler-checked lemmas from the main unproved conjecture.

weekly.assignment: Read pinned Lean and MathOS formal sources; inventory assumptions and axioms.
Formalize a small supporting finite theorem or verify a precisely specified calculation.
Run the real checker on an independent machine/CI and search for hidden placeholders or unsound axioms.
Compare the formal theorem exactly with the research target, including every hypothesis omitted in the formalization.

acceptance: real kernel/checker evidence for claimed small result
no sorry/admit/unverified axioms in claimed proof

modules.title: Independent review and research handoff
modules.goal: Produce a reproducible, critical research packet for expert review.

weekly.assignment: Pin code revision, data/provenance, test versions and known failure modes.
Have a second reviewer attempt the checks and document findings separately.
Resolve criticism or explicitly record unresolved proof obligations and false starts.
Present exactly what is established, what is conditional, and what remains Clay-unproved.

acceptance: independent reviewer identity and scope documented
final status stays NOT_CERTIFIED unless a separate approved scientific process warrants otherwise

tracks.starter: Derive the Li coefficient normalization and reconstruct its numerical bounds independently.
tracks.beyond_starter: An all-index Li inequality or noncircular spectral zero-identity, with every multiplicity accounted for.
tracks.principal_risk: Checking only finitely many coefficients or assuming RH in the derivation.

tracks.starter: Build and independently verify the 6-variable K4 Tseitin contradiction and resolution certificate.
tracks.beyond_starter: A fully uniform SAT algorithm with polynomial total bit complexity OR an unrestricted algorithmic lower bound.
tracks.principal_risk: Confusing lower bounds in a restricted proof system with P!=NP.

tracks.starter: Verify ABC Fourier identities and derive the conditional perturbation energy inequality.
tracks.beyond_starter: A theorem for one exact Clay A/B/C/D alternative meeting all data, forcing, domain and regularity assumptions.
tracks.principal_risk: Mistaking one smooth periodic solution or conditional estimate for global regularity.

tracks.starter: Diagonalize the toy transfer matrix and determine precisely how a regulator-dependent gap collapses.
tracks.beyond_starter: A nontrivial four-dimensional continuum quantum gauge theory with axioms and positive physical mass gap for every required compact simple group.
tracks.principal_risk: Confusing a two-state toy model or dimensionless lattice gap with physical continuum mass.

tracks.starter: Calculate the hyperplane-class ring and pairings of projective four-space.
tracks.beyond_starter: Construct and verify rational algebraic-cycle representatives for a nontrivial primitive Hodge-class family.
tracks.principal_risk: Assuming the general Hodge conjecture from projective-space examples or confusing rational and integral versions.

tracks.starter: Double-check elliptic-curve finite-field counts via Euler's Legendre-symbol criterion.
tracks.beyond_starter: Establish analytic/algebraic rank compatibility beyond a finite local sample with exact hypotheses; distinguish refined leading-term and Sha work.
tracks.principal_risk: Inferring global rank or Sha finiteness from local point counts.

tracks.starter: Rebuild the mod-2 boundary maps of the four-simplex and compute the 3-sphere Betti numbers.
tracks.beyond_starter: Reconstruct an actual Ricci-flow-with-surgery theorem chain and independently audit all geometric hypotheses.
tracks.principal_risk: Misidentifying S3 homology with simple connectivity or claiming a new proof of an already solved conjecture.
